# qestack

> qestack: QA and test automation skills, agents and quality gates for AI coding agents. One Claude Code plugin with a QA library (39 Quality Engineering skills and 8 reviewer personas for any stack, no engine needed) and a gated workflow with an engine that proves AI-written tests catch bugs (spec-first test design, red-before-green, test locks, hidden faults, mutation score, independent judge).

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add quark-sri/qestack`, then `/plugin install qestack@qestack`. Other agents that read SKILL.md: `scripts/install-skills.sh <skills-folder>`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/README.md): what qestack does, install, gates and limits
- [Why qestack](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/why-qestack.md): the problem with AI-written tests and the metrics
- [Architecture](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): engine, plugin, hook and project folder
- [Other agents](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/docs/other-agents.md): use the skills with Codex, Cursor and Copilot

## QA library skills (no engine needed)

- [accessibility-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/accessibility-testing/SKILL.md): Tests web and app accessibility against WCAG level AA
- [api-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/api-testing/SKILL.md): Writes or improves tests for HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL)
- [bug-hunter](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/bug-hunter/SKILL.md): Hunts real bugs in code, a change or a feature with a defect taxonomy, traces real values and proves each suspect with a failing test or exact repro steps
- [bug-report](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/bug-report/SKILL.md): Writes a clear, reproducible defect report from a failing test, log, stack trace or complaint
- [change-impact](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/change-impact/SKILL.md): Analyzes what a diff, branch or pull request can break, which existing tests to run in which order, which tests are missing and which changed tests now check less
- [ci-cd-integration](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/ci-cd-integration/SKILL.md): Designs or fixes how tests run in the delivery pipeline
- [contract-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/contract-testing/SKILL.md): Sets up consumer-driven contract tests for APIs and events
- [database-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/database-testing/SKILL.md): Tests persistence against a real database engine
- [edge-case-hunter](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/edge-case-hunter/SKILL.md): Finds edge, boundary and negative cases for a feature, function, endpoint or form from a catalog (numbers, text, time, money, state, concurrency, security), each with an input and an expected result
- [exploratory-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/exploratory-testing/SKILL.md): Plans, runs and reports session-based exploratory testing
- [flaky-test-detective](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/flaky-test-detective/SKILL.md): Finds the root cause of a flaky test
- [localization-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/localization-testing/SKILL.md): Tests internationalization and localization
- [messaging-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/messaging-testing/SKILL.md): Tests event-driven systems with a real broker
- [mutation-probe](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/mutation-probe/SKILL.md): Measures test strength with mutation testing
- [performance-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/performance-testing/SKILL.md): Plans, writes, runs and analyzes load, stress, spike, soak and capacity tests
- [production-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/production-testing/SKILL.md): Verifies quality in production after release
- [qa-navigator](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qa-navigator/SKILL.md): Routes a QA request to the right qestack skill or to the gated workflow, and gives the next steps when the request matches no skill clearly
- [qa-project-context](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qa-project-context/SKILL.md): Creates or updates .agents/qa-project-context.md, the file of project facts (stack, test commands, CI, environments, risks) that every QA skill reads first
- [quality-postmortem](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/quality-postmortem/SKILL.md): Runs a blameless postmortem for an escaped defect
- [release-readiness](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/release-readiness/SKILL.md): Decides go or no-go for a release with evidence
- [requirement-gaps](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/requirement-gaps/SKILL.md): Finds gaps in requirements before tests or code exist
- [resilience-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/resilience-testing/SKILL.md): Tests behavior when a dependency fails
- [risk-based-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/risk-based-testing/SKILL.md): Builds a risk matrix (impact times likelihood, with evidence) for a product, release or change, sets the test depth for each risk zone and analyzes the top failure modes
- [roast-my-code](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/roast-my-code/SKILL.md): Gives a direct code review with a quality engineering focus
- [security-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/security-testing/SKILL.md): Plans and writes security tests for an application or API
- [service-virtualization](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/service-virtualization/SKILL.md): Simulates external and third-party services in tests with stubs, fakes and simulated servers
- [spec-drift](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/spec-drift/SKILL.md): Detects drift between what is specified, documented, built and tested, and reports each mismatch with the likely truth and the side to change
- [test-case-designer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-case-designer/SKILL.md): Designs traceable test cases from requirements with equivalence classes, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions and pairwise, each with an exact expected result and test level
- [test-coverage-map](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-coverage-map/SKILL.md): Maps what is tested and what is not by requirement, journey, code area and test level, not only line coverage, and shows the pyramid shape
- [test-data-management](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-data-management/SKILL.md): Designs test data
- [test-environments](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-environments/SKILL.md): Sets up reproducible test environments
- [test-planning](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-planning/SKILL.md): Writes a test plan for a sprint, release, epic or feature
- [test-review-panel](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-review-panel/SKILL.md): Reviews tests or a change with up to 8 independent read-only reviewer personas, then merges their findings into one ranked list
- [test-runner](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-runner/SKILL.md): Finds how a project runs its tests, runs the right subset, and triages each failure as product bug, test defect, environment problem or flaky test, with evidence
- [test-strategy](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/test-strategy/SKILL.md): Writes a test strategy for a product, system or team
- [testability-review](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/testability-review/SKILL.md): Scores how testable a feature, module or design is before tests exist (seams for clock, randomness and network, hidden state, observability) and gives the smallest production change per blocker
- [testcase-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/testcase-reviewer/SKILL.md): Reviews automated tests or manual test cases like a senior test architect
- [ui-automation](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/ui-automation/SKILL.md): Writes, fixes or structures browser end-to-end tests for critical journeys
- [unit-testing](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/unit-testing/SKILL.md): Writes, fixes or improves unit tests for rules, calculations, validation and state logic

## Gated workflow skills (need the qestack engine)

- [qe-audit](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-audit/SKILL.md): Reports the quality of an existing test suite or module with qestack, read-only and also without feature tags
- [qe-calibrate](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-calibrate/SKILL.md): Measures how far the qestack judge agrees with human reviewers (agreement and Cohen's kappa) and proposes rubric fixes for the disagreements
- [qe-grill-spec](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-grill-spec/SKILL.md): Checks a spec before qestack test design
- [qe-harden](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-harden/SKILL.md): Runs the qestack quality loop after implementation
- [qe-judge](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-judge/SKILL.md): Gives an independent qestack verdict on the tagged tests of one feature with the qe-test-judge agent and the rubric, and changes no code
- [qe-plan](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-plan/SKILL.md): Writes a spec-first qestack test plan (test-plan.md) for one feature with the qe-test-designer agent, then gets an independent plan review
- [qe-prove](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-prove/SKILL.md): Proves qestack red-before-green
- [qe-setup](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-setup/SKILL.md): Sets up qestack in a repository
- [qe-write](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qe-write/SKILL.md): Writes the feature tests blind from test-plan.md with the qe-test-writer agent, without the implementation, and passes the qestack lint and trace gates
- [qestack](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/skills/qestack/SKILL.md): Explains the qestack gated workflow that proves AI-written tests catch bugs, and routes to the right qe-* skill

## Review personas (read-only agents)

- [ai-behavior-auditor](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/ai-behavior-auditor.md): Finds the shortcuts that AI coding agents take to make work look done
- [determinism-flakiness-engineer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/determinism-flakiness-engineer.md): Finds the causes of non-deterministic tests
- [domain-oracle-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/domain-oracle-reviewer.md): Checks each expected result in the tests against the requirements and domain rules
- [hallucination-checker](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/hallucination-checker.md): Checks that each API, method, fixture, helper, property, flag, path, endpoint and library version in the code or the tests really exists
- [maintainability-craftsperson](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/maintainability-craftsperson.md): Reviews single tests for clarity and ease of change
- [saboteur](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/saboteur.md): Designs small, realistic faults in the production code, predicts which ones the tests miss and returns a fault plan
- [suite-cost-speed-reviewer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/suite-cost-speed-reviewer.md): Reviews the time and cost of a test suite
- [test-automation-architect](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/test-automation-architect.md): Reviews the structure of a test suite

## Workflow agents (gated workflow)

- [qe-fault-seeder](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-fault-seeder.md): Creates realistic, requirement-level faults as patches (never left in the code) to measure if the feature tests detect real defects
- [qe-test-designer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-designer.md): Writes a spec-first test plan (test-plan.md) for one feature from the specification, plan, contracts and data model, never the implementation
- [qe-test-judge](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-judge.md): Independent, skeptical reviewer of test plans, tests and fault catalogs that scores with a rubric and file:line evidence and never changes code or tests
- [qe-test-writer](https://github.com/quark-sri/qestack/blob/main/plugins/qestack/agents/qe-test-writer.md): Writes or improves automated tests from test-plan.md for one feature without reading the feature implementation (blind)
